---
title: "ssoosshd ldap sync"
description: "Run the directory sync now, as the admin console's Sync now does."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Runs, in this process, the pass POST /api/admin/ldap/sync runs: the LDAP enrichment sync over every user who has logged in with the directory on, which refreshes their directory data and applies ldap.sync.disable_after and ldap.sync.reenable; then, with nss.enabled on, the NSS directory's full sync. It reports what the pass concluded and records an ldap.sync_triggered audit event whose actor is local-cli.

With --dry-run the LDAP pass reads the directory and changes nothing, reporting the disables and re-enables it would have performed, and the NSS sync is skipped: it has no dry run.

Safe beside a running server: the scheduled syncs are not leader-elected, so every instance already runs its own, and this is one more. A restart does not run a sync; the scheduled ones first run one interval after start.

The database is the server's, opened from the same config file, and is never migrated: its schema must match this ssoosshd. Exits non-zero when either pass fails, with the reason on stderr; the process log goes to stderr too.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd ldap sync [flags] [args]
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | bool | `false` | read the directory and change nothing; skips the NSS sync |
| `--json` | bool | `false` | print the result as JSON, in the sync endpoint's response shape |
